rules: redo of proposal 1: grown from co-change (files that land together, lift, support 5 or more, renames followed), then grouped domain-first behind small entries (ADR-1403 D1, D2)

nodes.title: The library's front door
nodes.why: The package root and the Library interface: the story's one entry, which composes every domain. Kept; references.ts and creation-order.ts leave it for Records. It also holds the saved-query engine (data-questions.ts), which it composes into the Library (step 1b, question_0532c9726e32).

nodes.title: Records
nodes.why: Domain: keeping any record, valid and versioned. Transactions and the record shape they write change together (schema/records.ts with each transactions file: lift 13.6 to 15.1, support 5 to 6), so they share a domain. The refactor makes records/ with this entry.

nodes.title: Transactions
nodes.why: Kept: the store, in memory and in Postgres, behind one 21-line entry.

nodes.title: Valid records
nodes.why: What is left of Data schema once each domain holds its own record schema: the validated, versioned record (contracts 3.1 to 3.9), plugin kinds, upgrades, and references to live records (references.ts, creation-order.ts, from Library API). Every domain reads it: a single source of truth (ADR-1403 D1). schema/types.ts is split per domain in the refactor.

nodes.title: The plan
nodes.why: Domain: stories, capabilities, contracts, edges, anchors and the code survey they are drawn against. Its schema part (arc's tree records: story, capability, contract, edge, anchor, pin, prCutover) moves in from types.ts. The refactor makes plan/. It imports nothing from Work.

nodes.title: Work
nodes.why: Domain: arcs, increments, waits, holds and the owner's questions. Its schema part (arc, increment, question, prediction, feedback, fyi) moves in.

nodes.title: Arcs and increments
nodes.why: Waits merge in (waits.ts lift 5.4, wait-writes.ts 4.8 with work-in-flight.ts, support 7 and 8). Pending plan changes and plan holds move in from Work model: an increment carries them until it lands, work-in-flight.ts already calls them, and plan-hold.ts reads WorkInFlight, so in the plan they made a cycle. pending-changes.ts with plan-hold.ts lift 17.8, with work-in-flight.ts 4.1 (support 3, weak).

nodes.title: Owner's inbox
nodes.why: Questions, predictions, feedback and the FYI family: what reaches the owner. With work-in-flight.ts lift 3.6 at support 4, below the bar: a nested sibling, not merged.

nodes.title: Knowledge
nodes.why: Domain: notes, decisions, search and the librarian that tends them. Its schema part (definition and the knowledge kinds) moves in.

nodes.title: Notes
nodes.why: The note commands come home: ranked.ts with knowledge.ts lift 11.9 (support 7), notes.ts with knowledge.ts 5.6 (support 8), notes.ts with ranked.ts 9.6 (support 6). Knowledge entrances (front-covers.ts, 19 lines) folds in: its boundary fails the deletion test.

nodes.title: Search
nodes.why: Kept: embeddings and word matching behind a few calls, read by notes and decisions.

nodes.title: Decisions
nodes.why: Decision log, Decision corrections and the Decisions parent become one: corrections.ts with adr.ts lift 13 (support 6), decision-log.ts with decisions/index.ts 19.8 (support 5). Nested under Knowledge: decision-log.ts with knowledge.ts lift 8.9 (support 6), decisions/index.ts with knowledge.ts 9.9 (support 5). Its schema part (decision, decisionNumbering) moves in.

nodes.title: The librarian
nodes.why: Links, Catalogue and Graduation fold into the librarian: each entry exports every name behind it (5 of 5, 5 of 5, 9 of 9) and each is under 120 lines, so each boundary fails the deletion test.

nodes.title: Rounds
nodes.why: Kept: about 330 lines behind a 5-line entry.

nodes.title: Health
nodes.why: Kept. Its schema part (health) moves in.

nodes.title: Projects
nodes.why: Domain: opening a project's library, wherever it lives.

nodes.title: Opening a project
nodes.why: Factory and product merge in: factory.ts with storytree.ts lift 12.2 (support 5), switches.ts 14.6 (support 3).

nodes.title: Reaching a shared library
nodes.why: Connection by address, Shared server and Outside writers become one: they are reached only together, outside-writer.ts with connection-error.ts lift 31.7 (support 2, weak), and server.ts moves in from Project libraries, since 28's tests already drive it (ADR-1242 D3).

nodes.title: Commands
nodes.why: Domain: the library's command families and the registry that gathers them. The registry's plan and note verbs are split out to their domains in the refactor. It also holds the ./verbs export (commands/verbs.ts): the protocol as other packages' families read it, the Library named as the context's library, beside the write routing.

nodes.title: Commands protocol
nodes.why: The one shape every command has, which every command family (the library's own and other packages') imports: what a verb is called with, its answer and refusal, its callers, and the verb and family types. Lean: no domain behaviour, and it imports nothing but Storage's write options. Lifted to the top level beside Storage on the owner's answer to question_0532c9726e32 (2026-11-26); the write routing it held went to Shared library (project/where.ts), and the reading across projects (elsewhere.ts) and the stale-edit refusal went to Notes.

nodes.title: Fixed data questions
nodes.why: Kept, nested: its command module uses the kit.
